headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Chase DeLauter leading the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. The Miami Marlins secured a shutout win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez pitching 7.0 innings of scoreless baseball. The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Boston Red Sox second baseman Isiah Kiner-Falefa has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. New York Yankees right-handed pitcher Kervin Castro has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow neuritis.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Pirates in 2-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a shutout win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez pitching 7.0 innings of scoreless baseball. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save, pitching 1.1 innings with 2 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Mariners 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Treinen Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry in a trade. Berry joins the Royals after being previously traded to the team.
